function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `biomarker_final` values from `assay_batch == 'B'` are reported in µg/L, not ng/mL. Since 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, these values are 10 times too large. We corrected them by dividing the `biomarker_final` values for batch-B patients by 10 to convert them to ng/mL. This ensures that all `biomarker_final` values are in the same unit (ng/mL) before computing the change, which is essential for accurate computation of the average change in biomarker level."}
